attchmntText: Innova Captab Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Innova Captab Limited filed an investor presentation for an earnings call scheduled for 16th November 2026 to discuss unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 496.3 crore in Q2 FY27, a 30.5% year-on-year increase. EBITDA rose 29.2% to 72.4 crore, while Profit After Tax grew 43.0% to 42.4 crore. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue reached 967.2 crore, up 32.1%, with EBITDA at 147.5 crore and PAT at 86.5 crore. The presentation highlighted strong performance in both CDMO services and branded generics segments. The company also noted commercial operations at its Kathua, Jammu facility commenced in January 2025 and recent GMP compliance certifications from UK-MHRA and PIC/S.

attchmntText: Innova Captab Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Innova Captab Limited reported strong results for Q2 FY27, with Revenue from Operations at ₹ 496.3 crores and EBITDA at ₹ 72.4 crores".
voiceSummary: Innova Captab Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. For Q2 FY27, revenue from operations was 496.3 crores, EBITDA was 72.4 crores, and PAT was 42.4 crores. For H1 FY27, revenue from operations was 967.2 crores, EBITDA was 147.5 crores, and PAT was 86.5 crores. The filing was made pursuant to regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The press release is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Innova Captab Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Innova Captab Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 4,962.99 million, compared to Rs. 3,803.81 million in the same period last year. Profit for the period attributable to the owner of the parent company was Rs. 424.22 million for the quarter, versus Rs. 296.70 million previously. For the half year, revenue was Rs. 9,671.51 million, and profit was Rs. 865.48 million, compared to Rs. 606.85 million in the prior year. Basic and diluted earnings per share were Rs. 7.41 for the quarter and Rs. 15.12 for the half year. The results were reviewed by Statutory Auditors B S R & Co. LLP.
